lesson_title: Swap It, Group It, Share It
hook_text: 1 998 plus 5 467 plus 2 002. Can you add it in your head? There is a trick.
clip_script: Kimberley tuck shop stock count: 1 998 plus 5 467 plus 2 002. Left to right is hard. But adding lets you swap and regroup! 1 998 and 2 002 are friends: 4 000. Plus 5 467: 9 467. Easy. That is commutative and associative. Now the concert: 4 rows of R1 250. Share the 4 out: 4 times 1 000, 4 times 200, 4 times 50. 4 000, 800, 200: R5 000. That is distributive. And subtraction? No swapping allowed! 500 take away 200 is not 200 take away 500. Swap it, group it, share it.
visual_style: Number cards sliding into new orders and snapping into brackets, then a 4 multiplying out to each part of 1 250.
mood: Clever and upbeat, like discovering shortcuts.
pacing: Quick card shuffles, a satisfying snap at 4 000, then a warning buzzer for subtraction.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out 7 times 48 plus 7 times 52 in your head.
